title: Ep 28 — Anthropic, Cursor and Perplexity all race to keep your data off their own servers, and the survey tool clearing a hundred and twenty-five thousand dollars a month
description: Anthropic, Cursor and Perplexity all ship new ways to keep sensitive data off their own servers within 48 hours of each other, while Google turns Gemini into Android's memory layer. Plus a deep dive on Zigpoll, the solo-built exit-intent survey tool clearing $125k a month, and why the sports-venue EV-charging gap remains unclaimed for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
